body:
# Death Time Ban
[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Datapack/Mod-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/death-time-ban)[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Andy71_Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/ETzFRjAFSZ)
## Overview
**Death Time Ban** is a datapack that lets you ban players for a customaziable period of time.
## Features
### Custom Ban Time (432000 are the seconds)
Change the 432000(5 Days) in **data/config/config.mcfunction** to every number you want

**‼️The Ban Time does not work offline in Singleplayer‼️**
